title: Day 2 of rebuilding my favorite childhood game day 3
author: takshit2
selftext:
I'm building a tower defense game Similar to Warcraft 3 custom map TTW and Element TD using ChatGPT Astra+Godot and Pixlellab MCP.

I have build the data sheets including the factions and tower information, concept art, and the core gameplay mechanics.

I'm now rendering the sprites. Here's the first animated tower I got. What do you guys think?

comments.author: WDLfootball
comments.body: That looks awesome! How did you create the animation?

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: I used pixellab to Crete and animate it. Though I use chatgpt to build the idea. The concept comes from dung Beatle. I wanted to create a bug faction heheee

replies.author: YannLeCoomer
replies.body:
Was hoping you had a breakthrough in the process but that's exactly what I'm doing too and it is taking major cleanup in a pixel editor at every step. That being said, I am happy with the results.

https://i.redd.it/jfvzlo2nkbrh1.gif

comments.author: Unturned1
comments.body:
I'm pretty impressed by the quality although you have some non-sense in the animation going on around the door opening and it forming those two connections to the barrel. It is a good animation except for how one note it is, which is a problem with timing the wind up and release all appear to be at the same speed. The other issue of course is pixel flicker. If you pause and ignore the animation when you have no lighting changes the pixels are all moving around, which is a consequence of the the diffusion model. The trick to reduce the flickering is animate smaller individual pieces they handle consistency better when you make it generate only a small piece. 

https://preview.redd.it/nraw3t94i7rh1.png?width=151&format=png&auto=webp&s=7dc151e36a818d429cbe730e818aa1d03181264f

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body: Wow thank you for the feedback! Really appreciate your attention to details. I will improve this animation. Thank you again!

replies.author: takshit2
replies.body:
Ah so you are one of those guys that hates AI. Well, can't blame you. You worked your ass for years to learn how to build something you are proud of and then you'll see people just using AI as a shortcut and getting the same result.

But hey there is nothing wrong with using AI. In fact, it makes your job easier. Don't treat it like your competitor, treat it as a tool save your time, get better ideas and improve your workflows.

I get it, you hate it. But the world is not going to stop, AI will continue to evolve and become more common. Use it or hate it, it will not matter at the end of the day as everyone will use it.

comments.author: Danilo_____
comments.body:
Sorry, but thats the think that make some people hate AI. You see for one second and its working, it looks good.

You pause and look for two seconds and... why there is a second flame showing in this weird place? And the reload device... why its making a connection from nowhere?

And you think it doesn't matter, just a small asset that nobody will pay atention while playing... but I bet that the other assets have small litle problems like this. And the code and the gameplay too. 

Weird little things that the AI decided for itself and because the human in charge didnt saw it, didnt care to fix or simply cant fix. 

And the AI flaws are somewhat more off putting than the old human made flaws. I am making a game with AI too.... but no way I will let things like that pass
